titleEn: Maximum Subarray Sum with One Deletion
title: 删除一次得到子数组最大和
summary: 选择非空连续子数组，并可从中删除至多一个元素，求能得到的最大元素和。
insight: 扫描到当前位置时维护两个状态：keep 表示尚未删除且必须以当前元素结尾，removed 表示已经删除一次。removed 可由之前已删除后加当前值，或删除当前元素而直接继承旧 keep。
pitfalls: 最终子数组必须非空，不能把唯一元素删除
删除是至多一次，所以答案同时比较两个状态
全负数组应返回最大的单个元素

solutions.title: 双状态结尾动态规划
solutions.idea: 滚动维护以当前下标为右端点的未删和已删最优和。
steps: keep=arr[0]，removed 设为不可达负无穷，answer=arr[0]
更新两状态与 answer=max(answer,keep,removed)，返回 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int maximumSum(int[] arr){int keep=arr[0],removed=Integer.MIN_VALUE/2,answer=arr[0];for(int i=1;i<arr.length;i++){int nextRemoved=Math.max(removed+arr[i],keep);int nextKeep=Math.max(arr[i],keep+arr[i]);keep=nextKeep;removed=nextRemoved;answer=Math.max(answer,Math.max(keep,removed));}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumSum(arr:IntArray):Int{var keep=arr[0];var removed=Int.MIN_VALUE/2;var answer=arr[0];for(i in 1 until arr.size){val nextRemoved=maxOf(removed+arr[i],keep);val nextKeep=maxOf(arr[i],keep+arr[i]);keep=nextKeep;removed=nextRemoved;answer=maxOf(answer,keep,removed)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maximumSum(vector<int>& arr){int keep=arr[0],removed=INT_MIN/2,answer=arr[0];for(int i=1;i<(int)arr.size();++i){int nextRemoved=max(removed+arr[i],keep),nextKeep=max(arr[i],keep+arr[i]);keep=nextKeep;removed=nextRemoved;answer=max({answer,keep,removed});}return answer;} };
